en: Colorized vintage view over a European riverside city. A river flows through the center with tree‑lined embankments and a bridge crossing it. On the right bank stand rows of red‑roofed buildings and a prominent white neoclassical building; on the left are more houses and a broad promenade. A steep hill rises behind the town, topped with fortification‑like structures and a tower. The word "GRAZ." is printed in red at the top left.
